Forecast consolidation (tab: Monthly-Forecast):
- Jan: $120k (60% weighted) — two deals in late-stage legal; one needs a minor SLA variance
- Feb: $85k (40%) — pilot-to-prod conversion risk (integration dependency)
- Mar: $170k (75%) — largest expansion (“Insights+” upsell) expected close
- Q1 total: $375k (blended probability 59%)

Account snapshots (one-liners per account in tab: Account-Rundown):
- Acme Corp — Renewal (core inference); owner: tessa_morgan; blocker: audit logs retention limit (security review ongoing); next action: SOC2 evidence by 1/18
- Acme Insights — Expansion (Insights+); owner: laura_bennett; blocker: L2 integration; next action: engineering healthcheck demo 1/16
- Acme Retail — Expansion pilot stuck on quantization margins; owner: tessa_morgan; next action: bench test results 1/19
- DataWorks (pilot) — procurement in progress; PO target Feb; owner: laura_bennett
- Regional Labs — small renewal; low risk; owner: tessa_morgan

Open items for us:
- SLA exception: one clause on data retention — I flagged for legal; Aditya, if we permit a short-term variance, we should note scope and sunset date
- Procurement timeline: procurement@acmeanalytics.com wants preliminary numbers today if possible to queue PO creation

Attachments: ACME-account-summaries-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet with tabs: Monthly-Forecast, Account-Rundown, Assumptions)
